ledger: Setting: indoor room with closed windows, round table with red/cream cloth, metal cups, coins/tokens; continuous camera move from close-up of hands (00:00) pulling back and orbiting to a wide view of the seated man in blue suit (00:04-00:09.75). No wind, weather, or vehicle motion implied.

Airflow: no evidence of any. Hair (slicked, static), bow tie, red tie, yellow pocket square, suit fabric, and tablecloth show no fluttering across 00:04.5-00:09.75; consistent with still indoor air. No effect lacking a cause.

Gravity on cups: cups rest flat on the cloth throughout, cast contact shadows, and only move when gripped by the hand (00:01.5-00:02.75 lift/reposition of front cup). No unsupported lift or float observed.

Gravity on coins: loose coins and tokens lie flat on the cloth in all frames; coins held upright (e.g. 00:03.5, 00:04.5-00:06.5, 00:09.0-00:09.75) are always pinched between fingers or pressed against a cup by a fingertip, so the upright pose has a visible support.
Coin stacks inside cups (00:00-00:02.75): sit at the cup bottom/rim level appropriate to stack height; no stack levitates.
Tablecloth: lies flat and taut over the table edge in wide shots (00:06-00:09.75); no draping deformation from hand pressure expected beyond what is seen; no unexplained rippling.
Apparent background motion (chairs, windows, people) is attributable to the camera orbit/push, not to object deformation; ruled out as an environmental effect.

Lighting: soft window light from background; cup shadows shift with camera viewpoint but no environmental force implied. Cup count/coin-contents continuity changes are out of scope for this environment-response role.
